items.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
items.summary: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

items.title: Blockchain Association says Treasury’s GENIUS Act rollout needs clearer DeFi, foreign issuer rules
items.summary: The group filed comments on Treasury's proposed rule implementing the GENIUS Act, which governs who can issue and sell payment stablecoins.

items.title: Ramp Seeks OCC Trust Bank Charter for Digital Asset Custody
items.summary: The proposed bank would not take deposits or make commercial loans; Ramp says it would build products alongside its banking partners.

items.title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.
